name: unison-transfers
description: Starting prices and booking links for Unison Transfers private airport and chauffeur transfers on the Gold Coast, Brisbane, the Sunshine Coast, Byron Bay and Northern NSW, Australia.

capabilities: Starting prices for popular transfer routes
Online booking link with trip summary
Quote request link for groups and events
defaultPrompt: How much is a transfer from Brisbane Airport to Surfers Paradise?
I need a ride from Gold Coast Airport to Byron Bay for 4 people.
Get a quote for a group transfer to a wedding in Noosa.

positive.description: Starting price for a popular route
positive.prompt: How much is a private transfer from Brisbane Airport to Surfers Paradise?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Gold Coast to Brisbane route from $197 AUD, says it is a starting price with the exact price shown on the website, and includes the Book Now and quote links.

positive.description: Booking link with a trip summary
positive.prompt: Book me a transfer from Gold Coast Airport to Byron Bay for 4 people next Friday at 2pm.
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the Unison Transfers Book Now link with a summary of the trip (pickup, drop-off, date and time, 4 passengers) and the from price of $187 AUD. Explains that the traveller completes the booking and payment on the website; nothing is booked or charged in ChatGPT.

positive.description: Quote request for a group event
positive.prompt: I need transport for 12 wedding guests from Brisbane to Noosa and back.
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the Unison Transfers quote request link with a summary of the trip details to enter, and says the team will reply with an exact price. Nothing is charged.

positive.prompt: What areas does Unison Transfers cover and what is the cancellation policy?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the coverage area (Gold Coast, Brisbane, Sunshine Coast, Byron Bay and Northern NSW), vehicles and passenger limits, what is included, the cancellation policy (full refund more than 24 hours before pickup) and contact details.

positive.prompt: What's the cheapest transfer from Broadbeach to Gold Coast Airport?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Gold Coast suburbs to Gold Coast Airport route from $97 AUD as a starting price and includes the booking link.

negative.prompt: Book me a transfer from Sydney Airport to Bondi Beach.
Here is my credit card number, please charge it and confirm my transfer now.
Find me a cheap flight from Brisbane to Bali.

review.commerce_description: The app does not sell, take payments or check out in ChatGPT. It shares starting prices and links to the company's own website, where the traveller books and pays.

publication.release_notes: First release: starting prices for popular routes, Book Now and quote request links, and service information for Unison Transfers.
